director_contract.title: Spanish se: Reflexive vs Passive
director_contract.learner_message: I keep mixing up when Spanish se is reflexive or passive.

learning_context.root_problem: The learner is using the word se itself as the clue instead of checking where the action goes.
learning_context.misconception_target: The learner thinks se has one fixed meaning, instead of seeing that the sentence structure changes its role.

personalization_profile.profile_summary: Learner benefits from visual explanations with motion and concrete examples. Avoid long abstract captions.

creative_brief.visual_metaphor: Two different machines using the same lever
creative_brief.aha_moment: Se changes meaning based on what happens to the subject, not the word itself.
creative_brief.why_this_should_unstick_the_learner: It shifts focus from memorizing se to observing sentence structure, fixing the discrimination gap.

renderer_intent.camera_language: static, slight zoom on active sentence

conceptual_objects.name: Subject
conceptual_objects.meaning: Who or what performs the action

conceptual_objects.name: Se
conceptual_objects.visual_hint: a small badge that attaches to verb

conceptual_objects.name: Reflexive
conceptual_objects.visual_hint: a curved arrow back to subject

conceptual_objects.name: Passive
conceptual_objects.meaning: Action happens to subject by unnamed agent

relationships.explanation: Se attaches to verb and changes how we interpret the action
If action returns to subject, it's reflexive
If action happens to subject with no doer shown, it's passive

beats.purpose: Show learner's current focus on se alone
beats.learner_thought_before: I see se and guess its meaning
beats.visual_change: Se badge pulses alone while sentences flash too fast to read
beats.narration: You see se and try to guess its meaning.
beats.expected_realization: I'm relying on se instead of sentence structure.

beats.purpose: Reveal how sentence structure decides se's role
beats.visual_change: Two sentences build: subject-verb-se with action arrow back (reflexive), and subject-verb-se with action arrow onto subject from nowhere (passive)
beats.narration: Se gets meaning from what the action does.
beats.expected_realization: Se's role depends on where the action goes.

beats.purpose: Show corrected view and set up checkpoint
beats.learner_thought_before: I now check the action's target
beats.visual_change: Learner highlights action target in new sentences; se badge stays neutral
beats.narration: Check where the action goes to know se's role.
beats.expected_realization: I can tell reflexive from passive by structure.

checkpoint.prompt: In this sentence, does the action return to the subject or happen to it by an unknown agent?
checkpoint.expected_idea: The learner names the hidden relationship or rule in their own words.

safety_notes: The model writes a semantic director contract, not executable renderer code.
MyWay validates scene kind, object ids, beats, captions, and renderer capabilities before rendering.
Personalization is only used when it clarifies the root problem.
